regions.finding: The original image identifies the article as a Highlight Review; this prose supplies context but no new batch experiment from the review authors.

regions.region: lower-left Radical Cyclization prose and Scheme 1
regions.finding: One cited generic TsBr/TsSePh radical-cyclization arrow and the distinct TsI cis/trans-mixture exception were extracted as literature examples; the generic range was not expanded into invented substrate rows.

regions.region: upper-right Scheme 2 and lower-right Pd-catalyzed Cyclization prose
regions.finding: Pd condition A and B, short and prolonged distannane outcomes, and the GeBu3/GePh3 variants were separated into six literature-example records; intermediates 3/3′/4/6/8 are mechanistic states rather than extra experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 1 and Scheme 2 report generic scope ranges rather than substrate-level rows.
The Scheme 2 Ge variants only state similar conditions, and the distannane prose does not assign condition A versus B to individual results.
Generic X/Y substituents and small review drawings do not support unique substrate/product SMILES.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 3 and adjacent cascade-mechanism prose
regions.finding: The three-component Pd(dba)2 cascade was recorded once as a cited literature example with its generic 41–77% scope range; intermediates 10–13 were not miscounted as separate experiments.
The Pd(II)-catalyzed bisallenol cyclization was captured as one cited generic literature example; intermediates 15 and 16 are mechanistic.
The three I-1/I-2/I-3 cyclometallation modes are a conceptual mechanism diagram with no experiment-specific conditions or yields and were classified as one mechanism record.

regions.region: middle-right Scheme 6 and Rh-catalyzed Cyclization prose
regions.finding: The homo/cross-bisallene Rh cascade was recorded as a cited literature example with a 57–74% range and qualitative excellent diastereoselectivity.

The cross-cyclization mechanistic evidence, monoallene trapping, and seven-membered-ring reaction continue as figures on page 3; their records combine page-2 prose with page-3 image evidence rather than duplicating experiments.

unresolved: Schemes 3, 4, 6, 8, and 9 omit most operational details and substrate-level yield assignments.
Catalyst/solvent alternatives in Scheme 9 are not mapped to individual examples.
The figures use generic R/X/Y groups, so unique structures remain unresolved.

regions.finding: The 1b/1c cross-cyclization and products 19b/20 are explicitly presented as evidence for a mechanism; no product yields are shown, so both remain missing.
Monoallene trapping and Rh-catalyzed seven-membered-ring formation were retained as two distinct cited literature examples with separate generic yield ranges.

The Co/Rh and Rh generic cycloaddition scopes were extracted separately. The NTs/R=Me diverted 75% product, the no-phenylsulfonyl failure, and the qualitative R1=H poor result were retained as three separate exception records.
The Rh and Mo arrows were treated as two independent literature examples; CO pressures, Mo(CO)6/DMSO equivalents, time, reflux, and product-specific yields were preserved.

regions.region: lower-right Scheme 13 and continuation prose for Schemes 14–15
regions.finding: The Pd/n-Bu4NI head-to-head [2+2] example was recorded on this page. The thermal and Au reactions continue as figures on page 4 and were linked cross-page without duplication.

unresolved: Most review schemes provide ranges without individual substrate rows or yield bases.
Several catalyst alternatives and qualitative selectivity statements cannot be mapped more precisely.
Small/generic drawings, including 1g/28 and 1h/29, remain structure-unverified.

regions.finding: The thermal tail-to-tail [2+2] arrow was recorded as one cited generic literature example with xylene/reflux and a 38–78% scope range.
The Au(IPr)Cl/AgBF4 [2+2] arrow was recorded as one cited generic literature example with a 74–98% range; DFT intermediate 31 was not counted as an experiment.

regions.region: lower-left Summary and Outlook and full right-column references
regions.finding: Summary, acknowledgements, and references contain no additional reaction rows or arrows; cited references were not converted into new experiments beyond the explicitly summarized schemes.

unresolved: Both schemes are generic scope summaries and omit individual substrate yields and full operational details.
Generic substituents and the unspecified xylene isomer prevent unique complete structures/conditions.
